title: Counting the Days a Missed In-Person Appointments Slot Was Held
content:
**Q. For the no-show fee a missed In-Person Appointments visit carries, from which date are the days the slot was held counted?**

A. The days the missed slot was held for the patient are counted to the scheduled date:

- from the latest move, where the patient moved the visit;
- from the confirmation date, where the patient confirmed the visit and never moved it;
- from the booking date otherwise.

**Q. What shows that the patient moved the visit?**

A. A reschedule count on the appointment record of 1 or more patient-requested reschedules; the latest move is the date of the latest reschedule shown there.

**Q. What if the visit was both moved and confirmed?**

A. The latest move governs; the confirmation date is used only where the visit was never moved.

**Q. Worked examples?** (hypothetical, scheduled date 2026-12-10)

| Booked | Confirmed | Latest patient move | Counted from | Days held |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-01 | none | none | booking date | 131 |
| 2026-08-01 | 2026-11-20 | none | confirmation date | 20 |
| 2026-08-01 | 2026-09-01 | 2026-10-11 | latest move | 60 |
